reason: A named independent lab with the batch report behind the QR code is what I usually have to dig for, and 200 mg of bisglycinate with no oxide is a dose I can check. The pre-counted sachets are handy when I'm travelling, and $24.99 with an empty-box guarantee is low risk for one box.
objection: It's a brand new product with no reviews yet, and I read every review before buying. I also don't love swallowing two capsules every day.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the actual lab report on the page and confirming the batch number matches would make me comfortable. Without a real report, or if the lab turned out to be unknown or the report unreadable, I'd pass.
